Class ViewConfiguration<T extends BaseView>

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.view.ViewConfiguration<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the concrete BaseView subtype produced by this configuration
public class ViewConfiguration<T extends BaseView> extends Object
Describes everything needed to register a BaseView with the ViewManager, including optional deferred (lazy) creation and virtual-desktop placement.

Eager vs. lazy creation

When lazily is false the view is created immediately when ViewManager.addConfiguration(ViewConfiguration) is called. When true a placeholder entry appears in the Views menu (rendered in italics to signal "not yet open") and the view is created only when the user selects that item.

Virtual-desktop placement

column, dh, dv, and constraint are forwarded to VirtualView.moveTo(BaseView, int, int, int, int) once the view has been realized and made visible.

Menu-item ordering

Menu-item positioning is now managed entirely by ViewManager. ViewConfiguration no longer carries a menuIndex field; doing so coupled two unrelated concerns and was fragile when other items or separators were inserted between configuration registration and view realization.

    • getView

      public T getView()
      Returns the view instance, creating it on first call if necessary.

      After creation, virtual-desktop placement and the BaseView.onFirstRealize() lifecycle hook are scheduled on the Swing EDT via invokeLater so that any pending setVisible(true) call (which BaseView itself queues) has already been processed before placement is attempted.

      Returns:
      the realized view; never null
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the factory returns null
